one_line: Finished results in the first 3 seconds, each making step in a new clean shot, ending on the full window.

q1_hook.what: 0:00 a hand holds a finished transparent camera sticker against a plain grey wall; at 0:01 a balloon sticker, at 0:02 a mermaid. No text, no speech (transcript only "תודה רבה"). The Giotto box appears at 0:03.
q1_hook.why: Three bright finished stickers in 3 s pose a clear "how is this made" question that the Reel answers by 0:20 (H5, H1, R4), with new motion each second (E1). But with no text, voice or face the topic is named only in the caption (T3, H4, H6), and the product shows at 0:03 (S1).

beats.what: A hand holds up a camera, a balloon and a mermaid sticker, one per second
A Giotto Decor Materials box held open; a transparency sheet over a printed stencil, a marker in hand
beats.why: Product and tools in one beat.

beats.what: Top-down: a marker traces sunglasses, a popsicle and a lollipop on the sheet
beats.why: The first step, clear from above.

beats.what: Scissors cut out a traced popsicle; a cut-out held up
beats.why: Step two, a new close angle.

beats.what: A child's hands colour a mermaid, a watermelon and a popsicle on a white table
beats.why: Fast cuts and colour build energy.

beats.what: A hand sticks the colourful shapes on a window with a balcony view; the window fills up
beats.why: The result, bigger than the opening.

q2_flow.interaction_prompts: Caption only: "תשמרו לכן בדחיפות" (save) and "מי שרוצה תרשמו לי ואשלח באהבה" for a stencil file. Nothing in the video asks for either.
q2_flow.why: Results first and the finished window last bracket the process in a pay-off arc (R4, K2), and a new picture about every second keeps 24 s moving (R3, E2, R1). The steps are clear without words, but the saves and the stencil file are asked for only in the caption (R7).

q3_cta.what: None in the video: no text, no speech. Caption: "תשמרו לכן בדחיפות", "מי שרוצה תרשמו לי ואשלח באהבה ❤️" for a stencil file, "יאללה, רוצו להכין ❤️".
q3_cta.why: Two different asks, save and write for a file (C1), both purposeful (C2), but the file ask has no keyword so it is hard to automate (C3). Neither is on screen at the end, after the result is shown (C6).

q4_shown.what: The Giotto Decor Materials box and its markers from 0:03; tracing on a transparency; scissors; a child's hands colouring; finished stickers pressed to a window. No face, price or text on screen.
q4_shown.why: The brand's markers are named on the box at 0:03 and used in every later step, with a finished window as the result (S1, K5, F8). The marker is a tool inside a craft, so its claims are not stated (C7, H3). Hands only keeps faces off screen (S4, S5).

q5_edit.what: About 22 shots in 24.4 s, 1.1 s average: fast cuts in the first 3 s, longer steps 0:04 to 0:12, a cut every second while the child colours, then window shots. Straight cuts, no text. Mean sound -15 dB, no speech, likely music.
q5_edit.why: A cut every 1 to 3 s with a new action each time is quick but readable, all within one task (E2, R3), with motion in the first second (E1). Nothing is spoken or written, so a muted viewer gets pictures only (E4, T1). It ends on its payoff (E8).

q6_topic.what: Turning transparency sheets into colourful window stickers with paint markers; a summer-holiday activity. Serves a parent looking for a craft to do with a child.
q6_topic.why: A cheap, doable craft for a long holiday is a real seasonal parent need (K6, K7), told through bright results, with a surprise ("הידעתם??") in the caption (K1, K4). It is worth saving and sending to another parent (R7, R5).

q7_filmed.what: Phone shots: hands against a plain wall; static top-down on a cream kitchen counter; handheld close-ups on a white table with a child's hands; backlit silhouettes against a balcony window. A stencil sheet carries the creator's handle in small print.
q7_filmed.why: Top-down hands with the work large in frame is the first-choice, child-face-free view (S4, F5, F4). Daylight and a home counter look native (H8, F7). Full 9:16, sharp (F1, F3). The window shot is backlit, so hands go dark, but the stickers read well (F7).

q8_text.on_screen: None. No headline, label, subtitle or CTA. The only readable words are on objects: "GIOTTO DECOR MATERIALS" on the box and markers (from 0:03) and her handle in small print at the foot of the stencil sheet (0:04 to 0:08).
q8_text.caption: "מדבקות חלון משקפים 🍭🍉🐬". About 155 words: "הידעתם??" and a save ask, a materials list, a free stencil file for a message, the four steps, how to stick them, five hashtags (two in English), and "בשיתוף @giotto_israel" on the last line.
q8_text.why: With no text or speech the Reel cannot be understood muted or skimmed, and nothing names the topic or the steps (T1, T3, H6). The caption does all the work, with keywords and five hashtags (T7), but the partnership is stated only on its last line, under "more" (S7, T8).

weak_points: No text, voice or CTA in the video, so the steps and the offer live in a long caption; the product is a prop for about 3 s; a child's hands shown; the disclosure only on the caption's last line.
lumebook_takeaway: Open on three finished results in 3 s, film each step top-down with hands only, end on the full result, and add a headline and a CTA.
not_verified: Whether the music is a licensed track (none identified); whether the child is hers; the keyword she expects for the stencil file (none given); whether the partnership was paid (a co-author is listed, no label, "בשיתוף" on the last caption line).
